title: docs(qa): cover the #33761 ledger gaps and name --reporter=tree for per-file pin scoring
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RqpbNoSwR1NpeeVXvbe23v)_

Fixes #33969

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：测试清单补齐 #33761 账本 6896511848 的 7 行覆盖缺口(新增 4 条、2 条加条款)，权限集"双持有者"条目改成可现场跑，另把 58 条"每个 pin 文件一行摘要"的验证统一写明 `--reporter=tree`。
- 为什么改：QA 跑手 #33785 现场测过的 #33250、#33238、#33181、#33512 等改动，清单里没有任何条目驱动；非 TTY 下 vitest 默认只打总数，按文件打分的条款读不到每文件一行。
- 风险与回滚：只改 docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json，不碰产品代码与 RUNNER.md；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：access-security.json 的三条(cbp-master-read-opt-in、position-renamed-holder-carry、permission-set-address-in-execution-context 第 5 版)。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` 为 OK;新条目点名的 pin 文件用 `vitest run --reporter=tree` 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，普通文档 PR,席位复核后落地。

## What changes

| Ledger row / scope item | Item | Added / changed / already-covered reading |
|---|---|---|
| Row 11 (#33250 `writeRequiresMasterRead` opt-in) and row 16 (`security-plugin-cbp-relation.ts` had no exact citer) | `access-security.cbp-master-read-opt-in` | **Added.** Reader writes land under the opt-in; blind/hidden: insert 403 asking read, by-id update/delete 404; looker 403 object gate; CONTROL detail still asks edit, explain agrees; save door 422 off a detail and beside `ownerMayEdit`. Cites `security-plugin-cbp-relation.ts#resolveCbpRelation`. `parent-and-organization-write-guards` covers only the unamended edit question. |
| Row 12 (#33238 `renamedFrom` holder carry) | `access-security.position-renamed-holder-carry` | **Added.** install-local v1→v2 carries holders with no restart, CONTROL holder untouched, repeat idempotent, publish door carries, another package's holders never claimed. Active-save is knownGaps[0] (#33788, open). |
| Row 15 (#33181 pending single sign-on people) | `identity-auth.pending-sso-users-managed` | **Added.** add/import-sso-users, password doors 409, ban/unban without the admin plugin, managed 409s pointing to Setup → Users, non-admin 403, unmanaged 409. Wired host and the cloud provider are knownGaps (pins only). |
| Row 15 (#33512 cross-object analytics where) | `dashboards.cross-object-where-engine-path` | **Added.** Engine path: dotted equals nested and /data, orphan excluded under `$ne`, `$or`+`$null`, empty match, >1000 parents 400 not truncated, two hops/`$not`/`$field` 400, related-field 403 value-independent, cbp scope, `/analytics/sql` refuses. Native `$ne` parity is knownGaps[0] (#33792, open). |
| Row 101 (email immutability) | `identity-auth.self-service-profile-password` rev 3→4 | **Changed.** New acceptance[6]: the disabled field and `update-user {email}` → 400 `EMAIL_CAN_NOT_BE_UPDATED`, address unchanged; steps[6] sends the server probe. |
| Rows 196 and 209 (#33649 preferences in the emitting organization) | `integration-system.notification-preference-suppression` rev 5→6 | **Changed.** New acceptance[5]: a row under another organization neither mutes nor overrides the emitting organization's opt-out. The fix shipped with 18.5.0 (2673f59, #33779; its changeset was not consumed by the version commit, #33903), so the clause says an 18.4.x reading is not a FAIL and scores 18.5.0 on as written. |
| Seat scope (2): `permission-set-address-in-execution-context` knownGaps[0] | `access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context` rev 4→5 | **Gap closed.** Re-read: `permissionSetHoldersMeet` lets two packages with different namespaces each hold a set name, so the second holder is now authored in the fixture. The bare door answers 409 with candidates, `?package=` addresses each holder, and a stale or package-less row is refused. Pinned by `permission-set-package-doors`, `grant-permission-set-package` and `protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading` (all green). |
| Seat scope (1): clauses scored on "the summary line per pin file" | 58 items (list below) | **Changed.** Each verify (and the token door's pin step) names `--reporter=tree`; each item +1 revision with a history row. Count at origin/main 159757ab: 58 items, under the 60 stop line. Left out: single-file clauses (catalog-activation [5], `cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json` [4], `records-forms.list-link-filter-refused-whole` [3], `namespace-co-owner-name-refusal` [2]) and CLI summary lines (`cli.doctor-*`, `cli.qa-suite-execution`). |

The 58 items: access-security (anonymous-floor-v18-doors, walled-environment-metadata-operator-only, meta-authoring-trail-and-audience-gates, security-catalog-activation-and-clone-doors, security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report, grant-table-write-contract, parent-and-organization-write-guards, deployment-tables-platform-only, share-link-combined-gates, org-admin-assignment-boundary); ai (mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure, mcp-dataset-tools, mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction, mcp-tool-call-interceptor); api-backend (second-object-exposure-and-internal-fields, data-request-shape-and-query-arity, meta-read-doors-v18, error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code); approvals (email-action-token-door, request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility, act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate); attachments-storage (upload-limits-scope-and-ownership, chunked-upload-integrity); automation (flow-registration-verdict-on-read, flow-authoring-refusals-v18, flow-run-semantics-v18, inbound-hook-timestamped-signature, scheduled-work-opt-in); cli (migrate-meta-write-stored-and-all, organization-ownership-ceremony, meta-package-flags-and-explain, validate-v18-authoring-verdicts, verify-derived-proof-families, package-upgrade-plan-override-advice); dashboards (analytics-exposure-gate-and-measure-aggregate); i18n (flow-copy-translation-and-host-override); identity-auth (auth-gate-held-session-raw-host-families, api-key-expiry-lifecycle, cookie-session-renewal-in-process, default-organization-boot-invariant, import-invitation-and-sso-domain-answers); integration-system (inbound-mailbox-association, notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility, oracle-federated-read-write, mssql-federated-read-write); platform-core (v18-boot-refusals, protocol-18-handshake-and-stored-replay, settings-organization-isolation-and-platform-rung, serve-composition-v18); records-forms (write-time-option-and-element-shape-judgement, write-answer-advisories-rollback-and-tree-delete, comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps, v18-semantic-defaults, action-preflight-panel); studio-authoring (meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows, multi-package-item-rows, save-door-runs-authoring-rules, page-api-binding-reread-after-action).

Edits are literal text spans: every untouched item stays byte-identical, and each edited file parses to exactly the intended value.

## Tests

No test changed. The new items' pins were run with `--reporter=tree` at this branch, all green: plugin-security (3 files, 165 tests), spec (1, 26), lint (1, 40), cloud-connection (1, 6), runtime (1, 10), plugin-auth (5, 186), service-analytics (6 files), rest (3, 34), service-messaging (1, 14). The permission-set pins: runtime permission-set-package-doors (40), permission-set-address + grant-permission-set-package (49), protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading (18).

## Acceptance notes

- History refs read `#PENDING-33969` in the first commits; a follow-up commit swaps them to this PR's number.
- None of the new items was driven live in this PR. Their steps and answers follow QA run #33785's live run at a557fa38 (comments 6893194178 and 6893199839), and sources were re-read at main 159757ab.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: OK (433 items), re-run on the patch-round head `3b39e185`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0.
